Title: 494520-2026: France – Bridge inspection – Performance of detailed inspections of structures in the sectors of the Territorial Services (ST) Canal du Rhône à Sète (CRS) and Petite Saône (PS)
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Detailed bridge inspections with diagnostic reports and load-bearing capacity calculations are technically relevant, but these are contracts in France for several VNF structures (presumably framework/multiple contracts) and outside Germany, therefore only medium priority.
titel: Performance of detailed inspections of engineering structures in the sectors Canal du Rhône à Sète and Petite Saône
kurzbeschreibung: Framework agreement for the performance of detailed bridge and structure inspections according to the IQOA method for engineering structures in the Voies Navigables de France network in the areas Canal du Rhône à Sète (departments Gard and Hérault) and Petite Saône (departments Côte d'Or and Haute-Saône), including load-bearing capacity calculations and drawing preparation for individual structures.
projektlage: Gard, Hérault, Côte d'Or, Haute-Saône, France
wettbewerb_art: Award of engineering services (structure and bridge inspection)
gewinner_rolle: Engineering firm for structure and bridge inspections
gewinner_kontakt: Contract amount Lot 1: approx. EUR 40,000; maximum value of framework agreement Lot 1: EUR 160,000; contract amount Lot 2: approx. EUR 20,000; maximum value of framework agreement Lot 2: EUR 80,000
projektbeteiligte:
Voies Navigables de France (client, waterway network operator)
SOCOTEC Infrastructures (winner, engineering firm for structure and bridge inspections)
Tribunal Administratif de Lyon (review body)
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Pure service framework agreement for inspection and condition assessment of existing engineering structures, no design of new structures
- Focus on IQOA inspections and diagnostics, only occasional load-bearing capacity calculations and drawings
- France, medium-sized volume, no specific individual bridge or special structure in the foreground
- Not a classic architecture or structural design competition, therefore low relevance for sbp design services
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Contract already includes inspection and assessment services, little scope for additional independent checking engineer services
- Outside Germany, no explicit tender for an external structural check
- Possible long-term reference for know-how in the field of bridge inspection, but without a clear starting point for the sbp checking team
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction or investment costs specified; this is a service framework agreement for inspections.
naechste_schritte: No active acquisition recommended; project for information only. For future French tenders for new construction or major refurbishment projects of bridges by Voies Navigables de France, specifically check whether structural design or independent checking is being tendered.
notes: CPV 71631450 (Bridge-inspection services); framework agreement for a maximum of 4 years with tacit renewal; lots: Lot 1 (Hérault, Gard) and Lot 2 (Côte d'Or, Haute-Saône). Focus is on inspections according to the IQOA method for engineering structures in the waterway network (bridges, possibly other structures). No indications of new construction projects or major conversions within the scope of this notice.
